product_metadata.title: Serving Trays – Rustic Nesting Serving Trays with Chalkboard Surface and Decorative Handles – Charcuterie Tray for Coffee Table – Set of 2 Stackable Wood Serving Trays – Vintage Design
features: RUSTIC DÉCOR: Add style and personality to your home with our amazing rustic trays! Practical and sophisticated, our wooden trays are a nice touch to a modern or traditional home.

FOR A CUTE SURPRISE: This breakfast wooden tray has a unique chalkboard surface that allows you to write lovely messages for your family and friends. Help them start their mornings with a smile by add a cute message that will brighten their day.

PRACTICAL & VERSATILE: Use this kitchen counter tray for serving breakfast, snacks, or fruit. The rustic trays are a great addition to a coffee table or kitchen countertop. They have beautiful decorative handles that make them a lot easier to carry.

DOUBLE SET: Our set includes 2 farmhouse serving trays for more versatility. You get a large 2.7 x 15.8 x 11.9-inch wood tray and a smaller 2.4 x 14.2 x 10.3-inch one. They are stackable so you can store them easily when not used. Accessories not included.

MOTHERS DAY PRESENT: Order these outstanding wooden serving trays with handles for yourself or as a unique housewarming present for family and friends. Surprise your loved ones with luxurious breakfast bed trays that they can use daily.
description: Add a touch of style to your home with our rustic wooden tray! Enjoy the distressed wood design and vintage handles, as well as the luxurious finishing touches. These outstanding breakfast trays are practical and versatile, allowing you to elevate your lifestyle. Use them to organize your makeup, leave notes, remotes, and snacks in a super-cool way.
Why is this product for you?

The amazing wooden trays are wonderful home décor pieces that make your home look warmer and cozier. They have a chalkboard surface that allows you to write down special messages for your loved ones, brightening their day. The set includes 2 stackable trays that are easy to store.
